keepScopeSmall: Focus on one thing at a time
todayTasksHint: Ordered by priority and time; check an item to complete it
emptyTodayBody: Choose one genuinely important thing and start small.
virtualOccurrenceHint: Recurring tasks are expanded only for this window and persist only after an action or reminder.
noCompletedThisWeek: No completions yet. Your progress trail begins with the first finished task.
intelligenceWelcome: Turn important change into a quiet signal stream
intelligenceWelcomeBody: The intelligence module connects watch fields, trusted sources, deduplicated stories, and briefs; collection or AI failures never block your tasks.
intelligenceFeature1Body: Maintain topics, terms, and trusted sources.
intelligenceFeature2Body: Merge repeated coverage of the same event.
intelligenceFeature3Body: Keep sources, timestamps, and uncertainty visible.
learningWelcome: Make learning a durable chain of evidence
learningWelcomeBody: The learning module connects goals, knowledge nodes, lessons, quizzes, and reviews so you can see what you truly understand.
learningFeature1Body: Break long-term direction into clear knowledge nodes.
learningFeature2Body: Use quizzes and a mistake book to test understanding.
learningFeature3Body: Schedule the next review from mastery evidence.
coreWorksOffline: Core task features work fully offline
languageHint: Changes apply immediately and are never uploaded.
privacyBody: Tasks, completion history, and recurrence rules stay on your computer. Basic use needs no account, cloud, or AI.
dstAdjusted: This occurrence crossed a DST gap and was shifted forward by policy
taskTitlePlaceholder: For example: Finish the weekly report
notesPlaceholder: Add a completion standard, context, or next step
floatingTimeHint: Keep this local time after the device timezone changes.
confirmDeleteTask: Move “{{title}}” to the recycle bin? For a recurring task, only this occurrence is removed.
partialProgressPrompt: Record the part that is objectively complete:
industryEmptyHint: Create a field, then add official RSS or Atom sources.
addTrustedSourceHint: Add at least one trusted HTTPS RSS/Atom source to collect updates.
sourceProvidesNoSummary: This source did not provide a summary. Open the original link to read it.
noImportantUpdatesHint: Old content is not recycled to fill the page when there is no trusted new material.
name: Name
httpsSourceOnly: Only public HTTPS RSS/Atom URLs are accepted. Local/private addresses, redirects, and oversized responses are rejected.
createGoalToBegin: Create a goal to start a knowledge path
evidenceBasedProgress: Mastery is based only on answer evidence
scheduledByFsrs: Review dates are scheduled by FSRS
learningPathHint: Break a goal into small concepts, then build mastery evidence with objective quizzes.
learningEmptyHint: Reading alone does not raise mastery. Answers and delayed reviews create evidence.
noQuizYet: Add an objective question to a knowledge node and it will appear here.
question: Question
themeHint: Follow Windows or choose a fixed light/dark theme.
backupHint: Backups use consistent SQLite snapshots and retain recent daily and weekly versions.
exportCreated: Export created and revealed in File Explorer.
restartToRestore: The restore was validated. Restart the app to apply it; current data was backed up first.
recycleBinHint: Deleted tasks are retained for 30 days and can be restored here.
runtimeState.not_authenticated: Isolated Runtime is not signed in
loginStarted: PGA's isolated Codex sign-in was started. Complete authorization in the browser, then check again.
loggedOut: Signed out of PGA's isolated Runtime.
licenseSummary: Application code is Apache-2.0. Third-party licenses are included with the installer and repository.
briefOptionalAi: Optionally uses the isolated Codex Runtime; local features do not depend on it.
briefNotGenerated: Local tasks are already prioritized. Generate semantic guidance only when needed, up to twice per day.
welcomeBody: Choose a few preferences. Tasks, learning records, and industry intelligence stay on this computer by default.
welcomePrivacy: AI is entirely optional and uses an isolated sign-in directory. Every local core feature works without it.
closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when closed
closeToTrayHint: Keeps reminders on time; reopen the app from the tray whenever needed.
enableNotificationsHint: Show a local notification when a task is due; this can be disabled later in Settings.
blockedReasonPrompt: Enter the single most important blocker:
snoozeMinutesPrompt: How many minutes until this returns to To do?
invalidSnoozeMinutes: Snooze duration must be between 1 minute and 30 days.
resourceMetadataHint: Only metadata and original links are saved; full copyrighted text is not stored.
noResourcesYet: No resources yet. Add a verified tutorial, document, or course.
author: Author or organization
deleteFieldConfirm: Delete the field “{{name}}” and its sources? Existing news items are retained.
stageOutcomePlaceholder: For example: independently complete a demonstrable mini project
prerequisiteHint: Select only what is genuinely required before this node.
recurringScopeHint.only_this: Changes only this occurrence and preserves the series rule.
recurringScopeHint.this_and_future: Splits the series here while keeping past records unchanged.
recurringScopeHint.entire_series: Updates the series template without rewriting completed or historical items.
appTimezoneHint: Follows the Windows system timezone and recalculates future floating reminders after a timezone change.
generatingCancelable: Generating the brief. You can cancel at any time without affecting local features.
quietControlsHint: Due reminders remain pending while paused and are reconciled when notifications resume. The same controls are in the tray menu.
notificationsPausedHour: Reminders are paused for one hour.
notificationsQuietToday: Reminders are muted for the rest of today.
startWithWindowsHint: Registered for the current user only; turning this off removes the startup entry immediately.
priorityCapacityWarning: Today has {{p0}} P0 and {{p1}} P1 tasks, above the suggested limit of one P0 and two P1s. Consider deferring or lowering: {{candidates}}.
batchMovePartialFailure: {{count}} items failed during the batch move. Successful changes were kept; refresh and retry the failed items.
pageSelectorHint: Supports one tag, #id, or .class. Leave empty to monitor the whole page.
dailyLessonHint: Local rules schedule review first, choose new content whose prerequisites are met, and reduce the budget when P0/P1 load is high.
lessonNeedsPath: Add a knowledge node whose prerequisites are satisfied first.
lessonNotGenerated: No lesson has been generated for today.
proposalApprovalWarning: These tasks will be created only after confirmation. The approval token expires after five minutes and can be used once.
reportsHint: Reports are generated from local facts and never invent completion rates when data is missing. Schedule them in Settings.
localMorningBriefHint: Uses zero AI calls and relies on tasks, blockers, and already collected intelligence.
automaticScheduleHint: The local scheduler is authoritative. Turning off Windows notifications does not stop collection, reports, or lesson planning.
localRulesNoAi: Uses local rules by default and consumes no AI calls.
weekdayZeroHint: Choose the weekly report day and time.
intelligenceScheduleHint: Fetches enabled trusted sources only; no AI runs when nothing changed.
lessonScheduleHint: Respects each learning goal's daily budget and today's core-task load.
recentFailuresHint: Shows redacted local structured logs retained for 14 days by default.
noRecentFailures: No recent failures or fallback events.
breakingAlertsHint: Saved as a preference only; trusted-source and factual-quality thresholds still apply.
searchPreviewEmpty: enter a field name or include term first
allowLessonTaskConversion: Allow confirmed lessons to become tasks
allowLessonTaskConversionHint: Lessons still enter the suggestion area first and require an exact preview and confirmation before any task is written.
completionCriteriaPlaceholder: For example: ship a working build with every test passing
eveningTaskCheckHint: Only unresolved P0/P1 tasks are checked. Partial completion never creates tomorrow's task automatically.
noAmbiguousCoreTasks: No core task needs an outcome check today.
enableAgentRuntimeHint: When off, no AI request is made. Local tasks, reports, collection, and review continue to work.
budgetModeHint: Deep mode is a manual-job preference and remains subject to the hard limits below.
dailyAiRunLimitHint: Defaults to two. A 10-minute cache hit does not count as a new call.
monthlyAiRunLimitHint: Automatic AI stops at the limit while local features continue.
supervisorGuide: Industry supervision is not configured yet. Create a watch field, then add trusted RSS, Atom, JSON API, or page sources. Everything can be changed later.
tutorGuide: Learning is not configured yet. Create a goal, then add prerequisite-linked nodes, resources, and objective questions. Daily lessons respect your time budget.
